title: Infinite Campus AI-Driven Student Risk Model Leads to Cuts in Support for Nevada's Low-Income Schools

behaviors.text: An AI system developed by Infinite Campus and deployed by Nevada to identify at-risk students reportedly led to a sharp reduction in the number classified as needing support, dropping from 270,000 to 65,000.
The reclassification allegedly caused significant budget cuts in schools serving low-income populations.
The drastic reduction in identified at-risk students reportedly left thousands of vulnerable children without resources and support.
